ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
overview: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi) is a Central Government scheme that provides direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families across the country. The amount is paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 every four months directly into the bank accounts of eligible farmers through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). The scheme was launched on February 24, 2019.
key_facts: Annual benefit: ₹6,000 per year (₹2,000 per instalment, three instalments)
Mode of payment: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to farmer's bank account
Administered by: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Beneficiaries must have valid Aadhaar and a bank account linked to it
Over 11 crore farmer families have been enrolled as of 2024

eligibility.description: All landholding farmer families who have cultivable land in their name are eligible, subject to exclusion criteria.

rules.description: The farmer family must own cultivable land registered in their name

exclusions: Serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries (excluding Multi-Tasking Staff/Class IV/Group D employees)
All superannuated/retired pensioners who receive a monthly pension of ₹10,000 or more
Persons who paid income tax in the last assessment year
Professionals like doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants and architects registered with professional bodies

documents: Bank account details (account number and IFSC code)
application_steps: Step 1: Visit pmkisan.gov.in or your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)
Step 2: Click on 'Farmer Corner' and then 'New Farmer Registration'
Step 3: Enter your Aadhaar number, select your state, and submit
Step 4: Fill in personal, bank, and land details
Step 5: Submit the form — registration will be verified by the state government
Step 6: After approval, the first instalment will be credited to your bank account

faqs.question: How can I check my PM-KISAN payment status?
faqs.answer: Visit pmkisan.gov.in → Farmer Corner → Beneficiary Status. Enter your Aadhaar, Account Number, or Mobile Number to check your payment status.

faqs.question: What if my instalment has not been credited?
faqs.answer: Ensure your Aadhaar is linked to your bank account and your bank account details are correct. You can raise a grievance at pmkisan.gov.in or contact the PM-KISAN helpline at 155261 or 011-24300606.

faqs.question: Can tenant farmers apply for PM-KISAN?
faqs.answer: No. The scheme is only for landholding farmer families. Tenant farmers who do not own land are not eligible.

faqs.question: Is there a family limit?
faqs.answer: Yes. The benefit is for the entire farmer family (husband, wife, and minor children). Only one member per family is eligible.
